feature: The Photonz skill: an agent makes and edits pictures and videos in Photonz
summary: Photonz now ships a skill beside its MCP server, so an agent in a fresh session, told nothing about the app, did all four of your scenarios in the open Photonz: the Case 1 to 5 montage, the box in a cloud SVG, measurements on an open screenshot, and GOV.UK's design system as Library components with Hacker News rebuilt in it.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Run Scripts/install-mcp.sh once (it registers the server and links the skill), then start a fresh claude session in any folder. Or, without installing: claude --plugin-dir <repo>/plugin. Every run's transcript is in 2026-10-19-agent-skill-transcript.md.

try.do: In a fresh session, say: I made 5 clips in my history. Take the last 5, and create a video montage which has a title page, and subtitle pages per clip with nice consistent layout and transitions. I want to see clips with recommended zooms. Each subtitle should show Case N where n is the clip number (1 through 5).
try.shotNote: Frames of the MP4 the agent exported, one every 1.5 s over the first 36 s, not a capture of the window. The film is 2026-10-19-agent-skill-1-montage.mp4 (480p copy).

try.do: Say: Create a product icon svg of a box inside of a cloud.
try.shotNote: The SVG the agent exported (2026-10-19-agent-skill-2-icon.svg), drawn by Quick Look, not by Photonz.

try.do: Open a UI screenshot in Photonz, then say: annotate the ux with measurements around the major ui elements.
try.shotNote: The canvas drawn by Photonz's own renderer after the agent's run; the screenshot before it is 2026-10-19-agent-skill-3-measure-before.png.

try.do: Pick any of the agent's measurements in the Layers list and drag its end: it is an ordinary measurement, editable like one you placed.
Say: Here is a website: https://www.gov.uk. Build out the components you see on it and recreate its design system in Photonz. Then rebuild https://news.ycombinator.com in that design language.
try.shotNote: The agent's export of its board. The page it read is 2026-10-19-agent-skill-4-source-govuk.png.

try.do: Open the Library on Components and Styles: the eight components and the GOV.UK colours and type are there by name.
try.shotNote: The top of the agent's rebuilt Hacker News page, exported by the agent; the whole page is 2026-10-19-agent-skill-4-hacker-news-page.png.

try.do: Press Command Z once after any single step the agent took and see exactly that step come off.

evaluate: Does the montage read as one designed piece, the same page style and dissolve throughout, or would you want a calmer page style than Keynote Clean as the agent's default?
Is the box in a cloud icon the quality you would expect from asking for a product icon?
Do the eight measurements on the settings screenshot pick the elements you would have measured, and are the readouts placed where you can read them?
Does the Hacker News rebuild look like GOV.UK built it, and are the components the ones you would have made from that page?
Would you install this with one command from the repo, or do you want it shipped inside the app before you use it?
rough: No mock covers the agent tools or the skill: they have no surface of their own, and every step lands in the editor as the menu row or panel control it maps onto does.

No window captures: every picture here is a file the agent exported or a canvas drawn by Photonz's own renderer, because what an agent makes is the file. Scenario 3's earlier window captures are in 2026-10-19-agent-drawing.json.
The montage's pages use Keynote Clean, whose background still draws hard rectangles round its glows; that is the-keynote-clean-title-page-draws-its-starfield.

Measurement readouts crowd beside the two buttons and down the right edge when several elements are measured at once; that is the Measure tool's own readout placement, the same for a person (logged on an-agent-can-draw-a-picture-with-shapes-paths-te).
Text cannot be underlined, so the agent drew 1 pt lines under GOV.UK's links; they will not follow the words if they change. Filed as words-can-be-underlined-and-the-underline-follow.

Scenario 4's run detached its thirty list rows from the List Row component to word them (setting words inside a copy silently did nothing then). Fixed after the run: words now land on that copy alone and it keeps following its original; Scripts/agent-design-drill.mjs proves it, but scenario 4 was not run a second time.
GOV.UK's own font is not on the Mac, so the system is set in Arial, the fallback gov.uk's stylesheet names.
The install is a developer's: it needs this repo checked out. Shipping the bridge and skill inside the app is not done (design doc, Not in this slice).

Coverage: 284 menu bar rows, 215 run by name, 68 left out on purpose with their reasons, none still to do; 57 of 65 timeline right-click rows run a named command; 214 named commands plus 34 typed tools. Panel controls are reached through the typed tools (set_layer, set_layout, apply_style, set_transition and the rest) but no test counts them yet.
